results.description:
If you're a songwriter, you probably recognize that melody is usually at least just as important as the lyrics they belong to. If you're a human, you've probably experienced what we like to call "forgetting." Lyrics can be forgotten as easily as they're thought of, which is why most of us (Lil Wayne excluded) choose to write them down. Melody, however, can easily be forgotten as well. To combat this, many songwriters end up going back and forth between a notes app and a voice recorder app while writing in order to preserve both their lyrics and the corresponding melodies. With The Lyrics App, there's no need to switch back and forth between apps while you're writing. You can finally write your lyrics and record your melodies in the same place.

Rhyme Generator: The Rhyme Generator provides seamless access to thousands of rhyming words and phrases at your finger tips. To use the generator, simply highlight the word you'd like to see rhymes for (which you can do quickly by double tapping the word), then tap the Rhymes button that appears just above your keyboard. A list of up to 1,000 rhyming words and phrases will then be displayed on a scrollable bar on top of your device's keyboard. Tap one of the rhyme options to replace your highlighted word with the selected option.

Thesaurus: Use the Thesaurus to gain instant access to thousands of synonyms for your lyrics. To use the Thesaurus, highlight the word you'd like to see synonyms for (which you can do quickly by double tapping a word), then tap the Thesaurus button that appears just above your keyboard. A list of up to 1,000 synonyms will then be displayed on a scrollable bar on top of your device's keyboard. Tap one of the options to replace your highlighted text with the selected option.

iCloud Backup: All of your songs, lyrics, and melodies will now be safely backed up to your iCloud (as long as you have storage available, of course). If you lose your phone or have to redownload The Lyrics App for any reason, rest assured that all of the songs you've written will still be available and will automatically be synced to your device after you open the app while you are logged in to your iCloud account on your device. This feature will also keep The Lyrics App synchronized across all of your devices that are logged in to the same iCloud account. 

iCloud Drive: All of your songs, lyrics, and melody recordings will now be backed up to your iCloud Drive. If you've ever wanted to export any of your recordings, this is the solution. From your iOS device, go to the Files app on your phone. From there, tap browse, then select iCloud Drive (if it isn't already selected). In that folder you will see a folder for The Lyrics App, which contains folders for each of your songs. Each song folder contains a text file with the lyrics of the song, as well as a folder containing all of the recordings for that song. You will also be able to access these folders from the Finder on your Mac. In order to utilize this new feature, make sure that iCloud Drive is enabled on your device.

results.description:
Never miss a moment of inspiration!

The lyricist, rapper, song writer, or other creative genius in you thrives on inspiration. On the bus, hanging with friends, or even when you’re in the bathroom — inspiration can strike anywhere. Will you be prepared to capture it? Miss the opportunity and it may be lost forever! Rhymer’s Block is a unique app that allows you to quickly and easily capture your words of inspiration anywhere your life takes you. And if you have a creative block, it can help you with that too!

The experts say to keep a notebook handy to jot down ideas for your raps, poems, and song lyrics. Just try and lug around one of those when you’re out with friends! Since you download Rhymer’s Block on your iPhone, iPod, or iPad—it’s with you wherever you go. When the inspiration flows, open the app and make your notes. Nobody has to know that you’re in the midst of creating your next masterpiece!

You can create a Rhymer’s Block account and have your work automatically uploaded to the cloud to make sure it’s safe and sound! 

There are apps that are similar to Rhymer’s Block, but they just don’t compare. Here are the features that make Rhymer’s Block the best choice:

• Real-Time Rhyme Suggestions
Who has time to search for rhymes? Rhymer’s Block instantly suggests words that rhyme as you type. Keep that inspiration flowing!

• Rhyme ANY word
We know creative people have a language of their own, so Rhymer’s Block is designed to figure out what a word sounds like phonetically even if it’s not in the dictionary. fo shizzle!

• Slant / Near Rhymes
Finds rhymes that sound good without being a perfect rhyme. For example 'dark' rhymes with 'heart' - but they are not perfect rhymes.

• Word Frequency Analysis
Rhymer’s Block will show you rhyme suggestions for words most commonly used first!  No need to waste your time sifting through words no one uses.

• Color-Coded Rhymes
Rhyming words in each entry are highlighted with corresponding colors. At a glance you see the words that rhyme.  See your lyrics visually!

• Works Offline
On a plane, subway, or somewhere else you have to take your mobile device offline? With Rhymer’s Block you can keep working with your rhymes. Never put your creativity on hold! 

• Cloud Sync
Create a Rhymer’s Block account to keep your work safe and have it automatically uploaded to “the cloud.” You can create and access your Rhymer’s Block account directly from the app. 

• The Block
A Rhyming app with a social network? Yes! The best way to be inspired is by connecting with others.  Share your work on The Block and get feedback.  Explore the creativity of others. Give Respect and add comments. It's like a 24/7 Poetry Slam.

• Customize Your View
The app includes several customization options. Connect to friends on Facebook, create a Rhymer’s Block profile, or hide those “colorful” words in your rhyme. It’s up to you!

Download Rhymer’s Block today and become the envy of your creative friends who are still carrying around notebooks to create the words for their rap, poem, or song!
